g.text: C. GPU execution overlapping explicit synchronization

Intervals A/B still mix driver / callback / CPU scheduling. Existing handlers may also contribute. No kernel wakeup trace.
Marker, no-marker and bare modes run in the same process/binary with rotated order; observer effects remain visible.
